mapper.select: SELECT SUM(pv) AS total_pv, SUM(uv) AS total_uv, SUM(uip) AS total_uip FROM t_link_access_stats WHERE full_short_url = #{fullShortUrl} AND date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND del_flag = 0

SELECT date, SUM(pv) AS pv, SUM(uv) AS uv, SUM(uip) AS uip FROM t_link_access_stats WHERE full_short_url = #{fullShortUrl} AND date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND del_flag = 0 GROUP BY date ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT hour, SUM(pv) AS pv FROM t_link_access_stats WHERE full_short_url = #{fullShortUrl} AND date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND del_flag = 0 GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour ASC
